podee.desc: PoDee: an island at the top of the Windows screen with a clock, music, voice, AI chat, calendar and PoDy the cloud.
podee.free_for_everyone_windows: Free for everyone. Windows 10 and 11. The app speaks 16 languages.
podee.google_outlook_or_any: Google, Outlook or any iCal link. The next meeting shows under the clock.
podee.podee_on_screen_the: PoDee on screen: the island with its tabs and PoDy the cloud
podee.podee_s_tabs_home: PoDee's tabs: Home, Calendar, Health, Screen time, Controls, Music
podee.podee_sits_at_the: PoDee sits at the top edge of the screen. It shows the time and your music, listens to your voice, answers in a chat and tells you what Claude Code is up to. PoDy the cloud sits next to it and follows your mouse with its eyes.
podee.say_open_telegram_and: Say «open Telegram» and it opens. Ask anything else of an AI: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini.
podee.timer_text: The time left is right on the island, so there's no window to switch to.
podee.title: PoDee · Pody Lab
podee.water_for_the_day: Water for the day, 20-20-20 eye breaks and a minute of breathing.
podee.what_the_agent_is: What the agent is doing in the terminal, its «allow?» questions and how much of the limit is left.
podoo.a_simplified_remote_in: A simplified remote in your browser. Tap the keys, swipe between pages, open the bottom panel for sound, touchpad and keyboard. Nothing is sent to a PC.
podoo.a_windows_pc_a: A Windows PC, a phone and one Wi-Fi network.
podoo.any_phone_or_tablet: Any phone or tablet with Android 7.0 or newer. PoDoo has no iPhone app yet.
podoo.chain_several_steps_into: Chain several steps into one button: open a project, start the music, mute the notifications.
podoo.desc: PoDoo: a phone or tablet becomes a remote for your PC, like a Stream Deck. Apps, shortcuts, music and a touchpad, one tap each.
podoo.diagram_the_pc_and: Diagram: the PC and the phone are linked directly
podoo.do_i_need_an: Do I need an account or the internet?
podoo.does_it_work_without: Does it work without the PC program?
podoo.download_podoo_apk_on: Download PoDoo.apk on the phone itself and open it. Android asks to allow installs from the browser: allow it.
podoo.drag_apps_files_and: Drag apps, files and shortcuts on the PC. The phone changes at once.
podoo.everything_is_set_up: Everything is set up on the PC with a mouse. The phone updates the moment you drop an icon in place.
podoo.install_the_app_on: Install the app on the phone
podoo.no_account_the_phone: No account. The phone and the PC only need to be on one local network or linked by a cable or Bluetooth. PoDoo itself works without the internet.
podoo.no_the_app_on: No. The app on the phone is only the screen; the program on the PC runs the actions. That's why the PC program is required.
podoo.on_the_same_wi: On the same Wi-Fi the app finds your PC by itself. Tap it and enter the code from the PoDoo window.
podoo.one_tap_instead_of: One tap instead of five clicks
podoo.only_the_network_and: Only the network and the camera, and the camera is used just to scan the QR code. Nothing is sent to us or to anyone else.
podoo.only_your_pc_and: Only your PC and your phone, in your own network. No account, no cloud.
podoo.pause_skip_seek_and: Pause, skip, seek and volume. The track and its cover come from the PC.
podoo.phones_and_tablets_with: Phones and tablets with Android 7.0 and newer.
podoo.put_a_phone_or: Put a phone or tablet by the monitor and get your own Stream Deck: apps, shortcuts, music and a touchpad, one tap each. Any Android works.
podoo.run_the_setup_podoo: Run the setup. PoDoo sits in the tray and waits for the phone.
podoo.sky_glass_with_clouds: Sky, glass with clouds, sketchbook, clay and more. Pick the one that suits your desk.
podoo.switch_apps_on_the: Switch apps on the PC and the remote flips to the page made for that app. Photoshop, Figma, Premiere, OBS and music have ready pages.
podoo.switch_to_photoshop_or: Switch to Photoshop or OBS on the PC and the remote shows the buttons made for it.
podoo.tap_the_keys_on: Tap the keys on the phone
podoo.the_phone_talks_to: The phone talks to your PC directly: over Wi-Fi, a USB cable or Bluetooth. Pair once with a QR code or a six-digit code. No account, no ads, no data collection.
podoo.the_podoo_program_for: The PoDoo program for your PC, Windows 10 and 11. It's required: the phone talks to it.
podoo.the_whole_screen_turns: The whole screen turns into a touchpad. Type on the phone and the text lands on the PC.
podoo.title: PoDoo · Pody Lab
podoo.with_podee_on_the: With PoDee on the PC, the phone gets its page: the island, timers, tasks and a chat with PoDy.
podoo.yes_plug_the_phone: Yes. Plug the phone into the PC with a USB cable or pair them over Bluetooth, and pick that way on the app's first screen.
podoo.you_need_two_parts: You need two parts: the program for your Windows PC and the app for your phone.
podoo.your_apps_folders_and: Your apps, folders and websites with their real icons. One tap opens them on the PC.
podoo.your_desk_your_network: Your desk. Your network. Nothing in between
privacy.ai_api_keys_exchange: AI API keys, exchange keys and private calendar links: in Windows Credential Manager.
privacy.ai_chat_and_speech: AI chat and speech recognition: your questions go to the service you pick (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter or your own address), under that service's terms.
privacy.all_of_it_stays: All of it stays with you. The Microsoft Store version removes its data when uninstalled.
privacy.as_with_any_request: As with any request online, these services see your IP address. Claude Code agents send their events to PoDee only inside your computer (127.0.0.1); nothing goes online.
privacy.calendar_the_google_outlook: Calendar: the Google, Outlook or iCal links you add.
privacy.claude_limits_a_request: Claude limits: a request to api.anthropic.com as your Claude Code account.
privacy.desc: What PoDee keeps and where it sends it.
privacy.if_this_policy_changes: If this policy changes, the new version will be on this page. Questions:
privacy.lyrics_the_track_s: Lyrics: the track's title and artist go to LRCLIB (lrclib.net).
privacy.podee_is_not_meant: PoDee is not meant for children under 13 and collects no data about them.
privacy.podee_listens_only_while: PoDee listens only while you hold or press the voice button, and during a call recording you start yourself. Speech is recognised on your computer (Whisper) or by a cloud service if you choose one. Audio is not kept, only the text.
privacy.podee_runs_on_your: PoDee runs on your computer. Pody Lab has no server of its own: we collect no analytics, don't track how you use the app and receive nothing about you. Data goes online only to the services you connect in the settings yourself.
privacy.portfolio_binance_bybit_and: Portfolio: Binance, Bybit and OKX with read-only keys, and public blockchain nodes for the wallet addresses you add.
privacy.settings_tasks_notes_clipboard: Settings, tasks, notes, clipboard history, screen time and notification history: in PoDee's folder in your Windows profile.
privacy.speech_models_download_from: Speech models download from huggingface.co when you press «Download».
privacy.title: PoDee privacy policy · Pody Lab
privacy.weather_the_city_goes: Weather: the city goes to wttr.in. With no city set, wttr.in finds it from your IP address.
support.a_payment_page_opens: A payment page opens (it's in Russian). Type the sum and, if you like, a wish in the payment message.
support.desc: Support Pody Lab with any amount by card, Kaspi QR or crypto and send a wish for PoDee or PoDoo.
support.email_if_you_d: Email, if you'd like a reply
support.for_example_show_the: For example: show the weather on the island
support.no_payment_needed_for: No payment needed for this. Tell us what PoDee or PoDoo is missing, or which app to make next. We read every wish.
support.pody_lab_s_apps: Pody Lab's apps are free. If they help you, send any amount you like. The money goes into new features and the next apps.
support.tap_kaspi_qr_and: Tap «Kaspi QR» and point the camera at the code.
support.thanks_got_it_we: Thanks, got it. We'll read it.
support.title: Support · Pody Lab
support.you_can_also_send: You can also send a wish with a donation: in the payment message by card, or in the transfer comment in TON.
podee.inside_sub: Point at a card and the island opens its tab. It looks the same on your screen.
clean.title: Make your desktop even cleaner
clean.sub: PoDee can tidy away the clutter. One checkbox brings it all back.
clean.icons_text: Settings → Dock → “Hide desktop icons”. Untick it or close PoDee and the icons come back.
clean.bar: The dock instead of the taskbar
clean.bar_text: Apps open from the dock and the Windows taskbar steps aside. Turn the dock off or close PoDee and the taskbar returns.
clean.wall_text: Nine soft 4K wallpapers made for the island. Free, just below on this page.
n160.title: New in 1.6
n160.taskbar_text: As the theme, white, «Midnight», liquid glass; full width or fit, at the bottom or the top.
n160.tiles_text: A click on a widget in the bar opens its panel: music, the week’s weather, the month, Claude limits, downloads.
n160.rules_text: Music pauses before a meeting, a warning about Claude’s limit, quiet hours, rules per app.
n160.widgets_text: Gmail, Cursor, temperatures, files, stopwatch, currencies, stocks, day timeline, flip clock, YouTube, OpenAI.
n160.cat_text: Its tail grows from the body and sways, faster to the music. Lives on the island and on the desktop.
n160.start_text: Run as administrator, Task Manager, file location, groups in Start.
n160.safety_text: Where keys are kept, where PoDee goes online, how much memory and processor it uses right now.
n160.scripts_text: Any script can put a line on the island: podee.exe --say. Favourite apps on Ctrl+Alt+1…6.
n160.lang_text: Errors, tips and file names now follow your language.
fixes.v160_1: The taskbar: looks as the theme, white, «Midnight» and liquid glass, full width or fit, at the bottom or the top of the screen.
fixes.v160_2: A click on a widget in the bar opens its panel right above it: music, the week’s weather, the month, timer, load, network, screen time, Claude limits, rates, downloads.
fixes.v160_3: The blocks window works like the widgets one: sections, search, cards dragged onto the bar.
fixes.v160_4: Smart rules: music pauses before a meeting, a warning about Claude’s weekly limit, quiet hours, rules per app.
fixes.v160_5: New widgets: Gmail, Cursor, temperatures, files, stopwatch, currencies, stocks, day timeline, flip clock, YouTube, OpenAI.
fixes.v160_6: The cat is now Barsik: its tail grows from the body and sways, faster to the music.
fixes.v160_7: Right click on the bar and in Start as in Windows: run as administrator, Task Manager, file location, groups; Claude limits keep their shape with no numbers.
fixes.v160_8: A «Security» page: where keys are kept, where PoDee goes online, how much memory and processor it uses.
fixes.v160_9: Scripts can write on the island (podee.exe --say), favourite apps on Ctrl+Alt+1…6, power mode, the whole song’s text with a click on a line to seek.
fixes.v160_10: All 16 languages are complete: errors, tips and file names now follow your language.
n150.title: New in 1.5.0
n150.game_text: A full-screen game: a slim strip with FPS, load and reminders instead of the island.
n150.calls_text: One key mutes every mic, a camera mirror, dots for the camera and screen capture.
n150.widgets_text: Clock faces, hourly weather, sun and moon, load, headphone batteries, Steam games.
n150.viz_text: Bars, a wave, a ring and LEDs moving to any sound of the PC, a record with its cover.
n150.looks_text: Outline, shapes and frames for any widget, and one look for all at once.
n150.notch_text: The taskbar is glued to the screen edge like the island on top; the equalizer in colours.
n139.title: New in 1.3.9
n139.lang_text: RU or EN in the corner, as on the taskbar. A click opens the list of languages, the current one ticked.
n139.win_text: Right-click an icon and the app's name on top opens a second window: remote desktop, a browser, anything.
n139.groups_text: Drop an icon onto another to make a group. Open it, rename it, drag an app back out.
n139.qs_text: One click mutes the sound; every Wi-Fi network and VPN connection shows.
n139.weather_text: Two weather services: when one is silent, the data comes from the other.
n139.click_text: A minimized Telegram comes back at once, and Steam in «^» opens on a double click, as on the taskbar.
new.title: New in 1.3.8
new.langs_text: PoDee's interface in your language, from Ukrainian to Japanese. Pick it in Settings → General.
new.taskbar_text: Its own Start with search and a calculator, the bin, the clock, the battery and quick settings right in the dock.
new.previews_text: Windows show on hover with no delay, on any monitor, with a cross to close them.
new.dockside: Dock on the side or hidden
new.dockside_text: Put the dock on the left or right, or hide it behind the edge: it slides out when the pointer touches the edge.
new.widgets_text: A big clock, a calendar, to-dos, a note, photos and a world clock. Pick them by their look and drag them onto the desktop.
new.calm_text: The screen doesn't flicker, PoDee doesn't steal focus, and the taskbar hides without a flash.
new.sub: What came with the latest version. PoDee updates itself.

wp.sub: Drawn in code for PoDee: the top of the screen stays clear for the island. Each one is 3840×2160.
end.title: The island is waiting

guides.title: PoDee guides
guides.desc: How to connect Claude Code, your calendar, voice, AI chat and a phone with PoDoo to PoDee.
guides.lead: Step by step: Claude Code, calendar, voice with AI chat, and your phone.
guides.open: To open Settings, start PoDee again from the Start menu. No second island appears; the running app opens its settings.
guides.claude_sub: The island shows what the agent is busy with and asks you when it needs permission.
guides.claude_2_text: Each account folder has its own row and its own Connect button. With several accounts, press Connect all. You can disconnect them one by one.
guides.claude_3_text: PoDee adds hooks to settings.json and keeps a copy as settings.json.podee-backup. Claude Code sessions that are already open pick them up after a restart.
guides.claude_4_text: Appearance → “Next to the clock”: Claude's work shows right on the closed island.
guides.cal_sub: PoDee reads your calendar from an iCal link. No login or password needed.
guides.cal_1_text: Settings → Calendar → “Connect calendar”. Enter a name and the iCal link.
guides.cal_2_text: In Google Calendar: Settings → your calendar → “Integrate calendar” → “Secret address in iCal format”. It ends in basic.ics. The public address only works if the calendar is public.
guides.cal_3_text: In Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → “Publish a calendar”. Pick the calendar and “Can view all details”, press Publish and copy the ICS link.
guides.cal_4_text: Events refresh every 15 minutes. Choose how early to be reminded of a meeting in “Remind me”.
guides.voice_sub: Voice commands, dictation and questions to AI, right on the island.
guides.voice_1_text: Settings → Voice → Recognition. Whisper on your PC works offline: the base model is 150 MB, small 490 MB (our pick), medium 1.5 GB. There's also cloud Whisper with a free Groq key, and Windows speech recognition.
guides.voice_2_text: Hold Ctrl+Alt+Space and say a command, such as “open Telegram”. Ctrl+Alt+D starts dictation.
guides.voice_3_text: Settings → AI chat → Provider. With an API key: “Get a key” opens the provider's page, and Gemini's key is free. Without a key, chat runs through a subscription: Claude Code, Gemini CLI or Codex.
guides.voice_4_text: In Windows Credential Manager, not in the settings file.
guides.key_hide: hide the island and bring it back
guides.podoo_sub: A phone with PoDoo controls the island: opens it, starts a timer, adds tasks and asks PoDy.
guides.podoo_1_text: PoDoo goes on your PC and on your phone.
guides.podoo_2_text: In PoDee: Settings → Modules → “PoDoo link”. Commands are taken only from PoDoo on the same PC.
guides.podoo_3_text: Open the PoDee page in PoDoo: the island opens and hides, timers and tasks take one tap. PoDy's answer arrives right on the phone.
fixes.title: Fixes and what's new
fixes.desc: What changed in each version of PoDee.
fixes.lead: What changed in each version of PoDee. Updates arrive on their own.
fixes.v150_1: The game strip: when a game or a film fills the screen, a slim strip takes the island's place with FPS, CPU, GPU, memory, the clock and reminders. Clicks go through it, nothing is put into the game.
fixes.v150_2: Calls: Ctrl+Alt+M mutes every mic at once, Ctrl+Alt+K opens a camera mirror, dots on the island while the camera is on or the screen is captured.
fixes.v150_3: Over sixty widgets: music visualizers, «Now playing» with a wave of progress, a turning record, clock faces, hourly and weekly weather, sun and moon, a focus timer, device batteries, load, Steam games, a GitHub year and more.
fixes.v150_4: Any widget gets an «Outline» plate, a shape and a frame, and «One look for all» changes every widget at once.
fixes.v150_5: The island's equalizer in colours, down to the cover's own; the sound is split into 32 bands.
fixes.v150_6: «Dock» is now «Taskbar», with a «Notch» look; the island's «Flow» shape is smooth; Settings have a «Games and calls» page, and Whisper can be removed.
fixes.v150_7: Files to and from the phone with no app: the «Phone» button on the shelf shows a QR code; the phone downloads the shelf's files and sends its own photos and files to «Downloads → PoDee».
fixes.v150_8: For streamers: OBS recording and live time and the scene on the island, a drawer with Twitch or YouTube chat or any site, a colour picker, snips and screen recording with the mic.
fixes.v150_10: A taskbar built from blocks: Start, the language, network, sound, battery, the clock and widget tiles (music, the next meeting, a timer, weather, load, Claude limits…) — each turns on by itself and goes left or right in any order. The widgets window is big now, with sections.
fixes.v150_9: Clearer widgets: a right click opens a widget's settings, which show only what applies to it, connected ones explain themselves with a button to their settings, photos take a file or a folder and how to fit, your own meter colours; a new «Earth: day and night» widget; soft glass tints.
n150.phone_text: The shelf's files to the phone and the phone's photos to the computer, no app.
n150.stream_text: OBS on the island, Twitch or YouTube chat in a drawer, a colour picker and screen recording.
n150.earth_text: A globe or a world map with the twilight line and your city's dot.
fixes.v139_1: The dock instead of the taskbar is closer to the real one: the input language in its corner with a list of languages, every app's name in its menu opens one more window (a second remote desktop), and the dock's Start always starts an app anew.
fixes.v139_2: Groups on Start: drop an icon onto another's middle, open the group, rename it, drag an icon out past its edge; right click has «Make a group», «Add to the group», «Take out of the group». Start no longer slides up when many apps are pinned.
fixes.v139_3: Quick settings: one click on the speaker mutes the sound, Wi-Fi and VPN tabs, every network around shows, the tiles switch on the first click.
fixes.v139_4: In «^» an app opens with a click, and a double click opens the window for apps that need it (Steam).
fixes.v139_5: Weather from two services: when one doesn't answer, it comes from the other; until it's there, the tile says so.
fixes.v139_6: A minimized Telegram and similar apps come back with one click. Start, the bin and the clock appear smoothly when the mode changes, and Home's clock lines up with the tiles.
fixes.v138_1: PoDee speaks 16 languages, like this site. Pick one in Settings → General; the installer follows Windows' language too.
fixes.v138_2: A dock instead of the taskbar: Windows' taskbar goes away and the dock gets its own Start with search, a calculator and every app, plus the Recycle Bin, the clock, the battery and quick settings (Wi-Fi, VPN, sound, Bluetooth).
fixes.v138_3: Window previews in the dock show up at once and on every monitor; the cross on a preview closes the window. Microsoft Store apps show in the dock too.
fixes.v138_4: The dock can sit on the left or right and hide: it slides out when the pointer touches the edge. On a second monitor with a different scale it stays put, and it comes back if Windows moves it.
fixes.v138_5: Six new widgets: a big clock, a calendar, to-dos, a note, photos and a world clock. In the Widgets window you pick a widget by its look and drag it onto the desktop, and each can have its own text colour.
fixes.v138_6: Holding a file over a dock icon brings that app's window forward so you can drop the file into it.
fixes.v138_7: A timer can be cancelled from the phone through PoDoo.
fixes.v138_8: The screen no longer flickers, PoDee doesn't steal focus from windows, Windows' taskbar hides without a flash, and the charging bolt on the dock's battery icon shows at any charge level.
fixes.v135_1: PoDoo link (Settings → Modules). From your phone you can open and hide the island, start a timer, add a task and ask PoDy, and the answer comes straight to the phone.
fixes.v135_2: The shelf converts files: images to JPG, PNG and other formats, resizing, PDF from pictures, text from images, background removal (a 170 MB model downloads on request). Video and audio through FFmpeg. Documents to PDF if Office is installed.
fixes.v135_3: When an app in the dock has several windows, hovering shows their previews. Clicking an app that's already in front minimizes it.
fixes.v135_4: The island no longer freezes when the Windows media service stops responding.
fixes.v135_5: Ctrl+Alt+P tucks the island away at the top and brings it back.
fixes.v135_6: The installer closes PoDee before updating and starts it again afterwards.
fixes.v135_7: The tray menu has a new “Support the project” item.
fixes.v134_1: Whisper recognizes speech again. After the move to a new folder in 1.3.3, chat said Whisper wasn't installed. Autostart, lost in the same move, comes back on its own.
fixes.v134_2: In the English interface, weather, hints and voice errors are in English too, and the AI answers in the language of your question. Switching language no longer resets the timer and pomodoro.
fixes.v133_1: PoDe is now called PoDee, and the little cloud is PoDy. Settings, keys, autostart and the Claude Code connection move over on their own.
fixes.v133_2: The heart on the island opens the Pody Lab support page, with a QR code to open it on your phone.
fixes.v133_3: Starting PoDee a second time opens its settings instead of a second island.
fixes.v131_1: File Explorer and other apps started from the dock open on top of other windows, not behind them.
fixes.v131_2: The island can hide completely, leaving only the indicator. Point at the indicator and the panel opens. Turn it on in General → When hidden.
fixes.v131_3: The Drop, Spring, Smooth and Fast animations now feel clearly different, and the chosen one plays in Settings right away.
fixes.v131_4: The island shapes got names: Notch, Flare, Capsule and Cloud.
fixes.v131_5: Claude Code agents can be turned off one account at a time.
fixes.v131_6: A crypto prices widget, and transparency for each widget and the dock.
fixes.v131_7: Settings open without flicker, sliders reach the very edge, and the cat hangs on next to the open island too.
fixes.all: Every version and installer is on

pg.title: PoDoo guides
pg.lead: Step by step: connect the phone, set up buttons and link PoDoo with PoDee.
pg.connect_sub: PoDoo waits in the tray on the PC. The phone finds it by itself on the same network.
pg.wifi_text: Open the app on the phone. The PC with PoDoo shows up in the list: tap it, check that the code matches on both screens, and allow the connection on the PC.
pg.nofind: If the PC is not found
pg.nofind_text: Tap “Can’t find your PC?”. Scan the QR code in the PoDoo window, type the six digits from the PC screen, or enter the address by hand.
pg.usb_text: Plug in the cable and turn on “USB tethering” on the phone. Android turns it off every time the cable is unplugged, so turn it on each time. The app then finds the PC by itself.
pg.bt_text: First pair the phone with the PC in Windows settings. Then pick Bluetooth on the first screen of the app. The first load takes a few seconds.
pg.buttons_sub: Everything is set up on the PC with the mouse. The phone updates right away.
pg.b1_text: A button can be an app, a website, a folder or file, a key combination, a script or a set of actions. Apps can simply be dragged onto the page.
pg.b2_text: Several steps in one button: open a project, start music, mute notifications.
pg.b3: Tie a page to an app
pg.b3_text: Pick apps for a page. When one of them is active on the PC, the dock switches to that page by itself. With none picked, you swipe to it.
pg.b4_text: Sketchbook, Clay, Console, Poster, Glass and more. You can set your own background.
pp.sub: With PoDee on the PC, PoDoo gets a PoDee page. From it you control the PoDee island right from your phone.
pp.s1_text: You need PoDee 1.3.5 and PoDoo 1.0.1 or newer.
pp.s2: Turn on the link in PoDee
pp.s2_text: Settings → Modules → “Link with PoDoo”. Nothing to turn on in PoDoo itself.
pp.s3_text: It shows up in the dock on the phone by itself. Open or hide the island, start a timer, add a task, ask PoDy. The answer from PoDy comes to the phone, and the chat is kept.
pp.safe: PoDee takes commands only from PoDoo on the same PC.
pp.reply: Your call is at 3 pm, 28 minutes from now.
pp.hint: Tap the buttons on the phone
pf.lead: What changed in each PoDoo version.
pf.v102_1: The timer on the PoDee page asks how long to set it for, and you can cancel it from the phone. Needs PoDee 1.3.6 or newer.
pf.v102_2: The PoDoo installer speaks 16 languages and follows Windows’ language; its text no longer turns into gibberish.
pf.v102_3: The phone app now runs on Android 7.0 or newer (it was 5.0): Google Play’s automatic protection requires it.
pf.v101_1: PoDy answers right on the phone. “Ask PoDy” is now a chat: questions and answers stay after a restart. Needs PoDee 1.3.5.
pf.v101_2: The keyboard no longer covers the input field: asking PoDy used to blank the screen.
pf.v101_3: The “Glass · clouds” theme is light now: white frosted plates, dark text, mint highlight.
pf.v100_1: First release: apps, folders and websites open from the phone in one tap. Music, volume, touchpad and keyboard too.
pf.v100_2: Connect over Wi-Fi (QR code or address), a USB cable or Bluetooth. The app finds the PC with PoDoo by itself.
pf.v100_3: Themes Sketchbook, Clay, Console, Poster, Glass and more, backgrounds and your own pictures.
pf.v100_4: With PoDee on the PC, a PoDee page shows up on the phone.
podoo.need_line: A Windows PC and an Android phone or tablet. They connect over Wi-Fi, a USB cable or Bluetooth.
podoo.connect_text: The app finds your PC by itself over Wi-Fi, a USB cable or Bluetooth. Tap it and confirm the code from the PoDoo window.
podoo_privacy.title: PoDoo privacy · Pody Lab
podoo_privacy.desc: What data PoDoo keeps and where it sends it. Privacy policy of PoDoo.
podoo_privacy.short: PoDoo is an Android app and a Windows program that turn your phone into a remote for your computer. PoDoo has no servers, accounts, ads or analytics. We collect no data, and the app sends nothing to the developer or to third parties.
podoo_privacy.stored_phone: On the phone: the addresses of your computers (the last five), the chosen language, the access key to your PC and the look settings. They live in the app's storage and are removed with the app.
podoo_privacy.stored_pc: On the computer: panel settings (pages, icons, theme), the list of connected devices and the access key, in the %APPDATA%\PoDoo folder.
podoo_privacy.link_h: How the phone talks to the computer
podoo_privacy.link: The phone and the PC talk directly: over your home Wi-Fi network, over Bluetooth (if the phone is paired with the computer) or over a USB cable in USB tethering mode. Data never leaves these networks or Bluetooth range and never goes to the internet. So the phone can find the computer by itself, the PC program sends a short message inside the network with the computer's name and port number, without the access key. The first connection needs the QR code or the code shown on the PC; without it the computer accepts no commands.
podoo_privacy.perm_net: Network access: talking to your PC over Wi-Fi.
podoo_privacy.perm_bt: Nearby devices (Bluetooth): only to list devices already paired with the phone and connect to your computer. The app does not scan for new devices and does not determine your location.
podoo_privacy.perm_cam: Camera: only to scan the QR code on the PC screen. The image is not saved or sent anywhere. Without the camera you can type the address.
podoo_privacy.children: PoDoo is not meant for children under 13 and collects no data about anyone.
podoo_privacy.contact: If this policy changes, the new version will appear on this page and the date above will be updated. Questions:
fixes.v161_1: Widgets and the island on a second monitor: drag a widget past the screen's edge, move the island with a button on its panel.
fixes.v161_2: «Song lyrics» widget: the lines follow the music, and it hides when a song has no lyrics.
fixes.v161_3: «Move settings» page: everything you set up in one file, with no keys or passwords in it.
fixes.v161_4: Dark glass for the island: the wallpaper shows through, and the chosen colour tints it.
fixes.v161_5: Coloured island: letters and dates stay readable on any colour, and a light colour gets dark text.
fixes.v161_6: A call on the island counts from its real start, and a program that merely holds the microphone no longer looks like a call.
n161.screens_text: In 1.6.1 widgets and the island go on any screen. Also a song lyrics widget, dark glass and all your settings in one file.
fixes.v162_1: Put the island on the left, in the centre, on the right or anywhere along the top edge: by the handle at the bottom of its panel, or in settings.
fixes.v162_2: Taskbar: a new «Merge» look with curved edges, while «Classic» now simply sits against the screen's edge.
fixes.v162_3: Taskbar with no background: every plate has the same corners.
fixes.v162_4: Settings: the indicator's position is drawn as a simple mark.
n170.title: New in 1.7
n170.shot_text: In 1.7 every screen freezes on PrtSc or a key of your own: select a part, mark it up and pass it on. Nothing is uploaded.
fixes.v170_1: Screenshot: PrtSc or a key of your own freezes every screen, then select a part, mark it up, pin it, print it or pass it on. Nothing is uploaded.
fixes.v170_3: General: one switch shows or hides everything at once, or set the island, widgets and taskbar one by one.
fixes.v170_4: Taskbar: the icon of an open app brings up its window instead of a new copy. Clicks work right up to the taskbar's edge.
fixes.v170_5: VPN connects and disconnects from the taskbar with one button, with no password window.
fixes.v170_6: Blinking tray icons no longer jump around.
fixes.v170_7: Drag-selecting on the desktop works with hidden icons too, behind the widgets and the taskbar.
fixes.v170_8: Less CPU when idle and less memory.
n162.place: The island where you want it
n162.place_text: In 1.6.2 the island goes on the left, in the centre, on the right or anywhere along the top edge. And the taskbar gets a «Merge» look.
fixes.v181_1: The × on the taskbar closes a window for sure: if the app doesn't close by itself, PoDee ends it after a few seconds. A window asking about unsaved work, an app in the tray and the app's other windows are left alone.
fixes.v181_2: Full-width taskbar: icons no longer jump when an app closes.
fixes.v181_3: Minecraft theme: the weather, music and clock tiles on the taskbar are square in every look of the taskbar, and on the light taskbar their words are dark and easy to read.
fixes.v180_1: New theme «Orbit»: every word and number made of dots, its own typeface with Cyrillic, one accent colour, dark and light. The island, taskbar, widgets, Settings and the power screen in one style.
fixes.v180_2: Power screen in «Orbit»: lock, sleep, shut down, restart or sign out with the arrows or the mouse, with how long the PC has been on.
fixes.v180_3: Wallpapers: a gallery that shows each one big before you set it; clouds by day and night, «Eclipse», «Planet», three Minecraft pictures.
fixes.v180_4: Taskbar «Over all windows» keeps its strip of the screen: maximized windows no longer go under it.
fixes.v180_5: Taskbar: quick settings like Windows 11, a rail on the side edge, tray icons remembered between runs, the AnyDesk icon shows again.
fixes.v180_6: Health: its own page, eye exercises with sounds.
fixes.v180_7: Widget settings in tabs; options that don't fit the theme are hidden.
fixes.v180_8: Charging is lit more calmly: red only below 20 %.
n180.title: New in 1.8
n180.dots_text: In 1.8 the island, taskbar, widgets and even Settings are made of dots: a typeface of its own with Cyrillic, one accent colour, dark and light.
n180.power_text: In «Orbit» shut down, sleep and restart are picked on the whole screen in big letters, with the arrows or the mouse.
